description: Added from Rust when the app starts (schedule.rs), not listed in tauri.conf.json, whose release build enables only `default`. What the schedule window (M5.5) may do: Zajil's own commands and events, the system's file picker (the user picks the file or program to open after a queue, #142) and its yes-or-no question (the user confirms it). Nothing else: no file system, no shell, no network from the page.
